Commentary.Commentary: Australia on the other hand were not supported by the field, they put down many catches and also missed couples of run outs. The captain gave eight different bowlers to get him a wicket but neither of them impressed. A good wicket to bat on but the Aussies will have to play well to get to this score of India. Should be a good chase. Join us in a short while for the action.

After a good start from the openers 300 was always on the cards. They slightly lost their way after couple of wickets but handy contributions towards the end ensured they reached 328. The Indian openers got them off to a flyer. The captain got a life early in his innings after he was caught off a no-ball. Both the openers will feel harden about the fact that they didn't get to their hundreds. Shubman Gill came in and played like an un-sung hero and a late cameo from Abhishek Sharma added the finishing touches for the Indians.
Over pitched ball on leg, Juyal heaves this over mid-wicket and they pick up a brace to end the innings. INDIA FINISH ON 328/7 AFTER 50 OVERS.
Slow ball on off, Juyal cuts it past point for a brace.
Outside off, slow ball Juyal swings and misses.
FOUR! Slow ball outside off, Juyal cuts it away behind backward point for a boundary.
Aryan Juyal comes in next to bat.

OUT! Bowled him! He has kicked the ball on the stumps on his follow through. Slow ball around off and Singh goes to reserve sweep this. The ball hits his glove and goes on his foot and later hits the stumps. He doesn't have any idea about it.
FOUR! Length ball on leg, Singh sweeps and the ball races away towards the wide fine leg fielder for a boundary.
Length ball, Singh comes down the pitch and hits it on leg for a run.
The short of length delivery has been cut away through square on the off side. One run added to the total.
Wide down the leg side, the batsman leaves it alone. The umpire has signalled a wide.
SIX! Slow again on leg  the batsman gets to the pitch of the ball and connects, hits it well over mid-wicket for a maximum. That was six from the time it left the bat of the batsman.
The batsman has just lofted it over mid off. The batsmen have run through for a single.
2 Wides. Slow ball outside leg stump and Kamlesh leaves it alone. The keeper cannot collect it and they run of the miss field.
Slow again, Kamlesh lftsn it high to mid on but the ball falls safe. Yet Another two runs.
Slow ball, the batsman was beaten and missed the line of the delivery and goes on the bounce to the keeper.
FOUR! High full toss on leg, Singh helps it on his way to the fine leg boundary.
Shiva Singh comes in next to bat.
OUT! Slow ball, Sharma looking to heavy it over the mid-wicket fielder but it goes to the fielder there who takes the simplest of catches.
SIX! Neatly done! Slow ball on leg, Sharma uses his bottom hand and flicks it over the fine leg region for a maximum.
Sharma lofts this full pitched ball around off over covers and they come back for the second.
Length ball, Nagarkoti makes room and slaps it behind the blower for a run.
The batsman goes after this one but misses the line completely.
SIX! Slow ball picked up nicely by Sharma and he opens his arms and lofts this over mid-wicket for half a dozen.
Slow ball, Kamlesh defends this ball on leg to pick up a run.
Kamlesh Nagarkoti comes in next to bat.

OUT! Brilliant catch from the fielder. Jason the fielder there dives forward to take a stunner. Slow ball around off, Roy looks to go over the fielder but doesn't time it well enough. Jason completes the formalities.
Sharma lofts this pitched ball over mid off for a run.
FOUR! Drifting down the leg and Sharma just helps it on it's way to the wide fine leg boundary.
Leg bye! Length ball on leg, Roy looks for the flick but the ball hits his pads. They run on the leg-bye.
FOUR! Loose ball, Over pitched on leg and Sharma lofts it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
The batsman was beaten and missed the line of the delivery.
Abhishek Sharma comes out to bat next.
OUT! Good catch! Pure reflexes that from Edwards. Slow ball at a good length and Gill slaps this back to the bowler. Edwards sticks his hands out and takes a blinder.
DROPPED again! Slow ball around off, Gill lofts this over mid on and the fielder doesn't judge the ball. Puts down a sitter. The batsmen come back for then second run.
FOUR! What a hit from Gill, just opening his shoulders now. In the zone to be hit and Gill lofts it over mid-wicket for another boundary.
Fuller ball, Roy works it to mid on for a run.
FOUR! Slower ball at a full length in line of the stumps and this time Gill hits it back off the bowler for a boundary.
Good blowing. Slow again in line of the stumps the ball bets the edge of the bat and flies to mid on . They come back for the second.
Slow again and the ball gets a top edge but falls short again of the fielder. Another run taken.
Slight over pitched, Roy lofts this over mid-wicket for two runs. The fielder dives to save a certain boundary.
Slow ball, Gill gets an edge to it and the ball is gone to short third man for a run.
Length ball on middle and leg, Roy works it to mid on for a run.
Austin Waugh comes in to bowl.

FOUR! That's fifty for Gill. Lucky for him this top edge doesn't fall to the fielder. Length ball and Gill swings his bat, it goes high but wide of the fielder and bounces away to the fine leg boundary.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.
Anukul Sudhakar Roy comes in next.
OUT! After three yorkers, this ball is bowled at a good length and Rana looks to cut this past point. Doesn't time it and this time the catch is taken at backward point.
Slower this time and almost yorked him again. This time on leg and Gill gets to the ball and plays it to mid on for a run.
Slow yorker. Right the the block hole. Gill blocks it.
Slow yorker. Right the the block hole. Gill blocks it.
Jack Edwards comes in for his last spell.
Full this time, Gill works it to mid on for a run.
DROPPED! And it's Pope again! This time at fine leg. Short ball is pulled away straight to wide fine leg, Pope there drops another sitter. They pick up a run.
Played to the point region by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Slow ball around off, Gill goes for the heavy but misses it.
FOUR! Show ball again on a good length around off, Gill picks it up and slaps it behind the bowler for a boundary.
Slow short ball on leg, Rana slaps it behind the blower for a run.
SIX! Full toss and Gill extends his arms to deposit this ball over the boundary for a maximum.
Full toss outside off, Gill cuts it to deep point for a brace.
A short delivery which has been pulled away. They pick up a single.
Pitched up, Gill drives this past cover for a run.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. The batsmen have run through for a single.

DROPPED! And it's a sitter. A regulation catch which should have been taken. Slow ball, Rana gives room and looks to go over the covers. Doesn't time it well and it goes to Pope who is stationed there. He gets behind the ball but puts it down.
Pitched up in line of the stumps, the batsman has driven that ball straight back.
Played to the point region by the batsman.
FOUR! Short and pulled away by Gill through mid-wicket and the ball races away for a boundary.
Fires this at a good length in line of the stumps, Gill defends this ball.
Pitched up again, Gill milks this past mid-wicket to run back for the second run.
Slow ball fuller in length on leg stump, Gill makes room and punches it to covers.
Third bouncer of the over. Rana does well to evade it.
Pitched up around off and Gill drives it through covers for a run.
Short again, surprised not to be called a wide. One-for the over given by the umpire.
Bouncer! The batsman ducks under it at the last moment.
Slow ball and a good length, Rana just plays it towards the bowler to pick up a quick single.
Played to the point region by the batsman.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Over pitched ball and Gill flicks it away powerfully towards mid-wicket for two runs. A brilliant effort from the fielder there has saved a certain boundary.
Gill works this full ball to mid on.
Back of a length this time, Gill rocks back and punches this.
Fuller again, Rana works it to mid-wicket for a run.
Down the length side, takes it on the full and Rana flicks it to square leg for a brace.
Xavier Bartlett comes to bowl again.
The ball is way outside the off stump, easy leave for the batsman.
Pitched up again, Gill drives it to covers.
Outside off, Gill leaves it alone.
Over pitched ball around off, Rana drives it past covers for a run.
Bouncer! The batsman does well to evade it.
Length ball, Gill nudges it to mid on to move to the other end.
Full again and Gill helps this to mid on for a run.
Good running. Tossed up ball on middle and leg, Rana sweeps this behind square and they come back for the third run.
Pitched up, Gill works it to mid on for another run.
FOUR! Kohli-esque cover drive. Overpitched ball Gill leans forward to hit it past the cover fielder for a boundary.
Slower ball, Gill works it on through the leg side for a run.
Tossed up in line of the stumps, Gill plays it to mid-wicket.
The batsman has dug out that slow yorker at the last second.
Short ball outside off, Rana opens the face of the bat at the last moment and guides it to third man for a run.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman.
Length ball around off and Gill plays it on the off side for another run.
The batsman chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
Short ball, Gill pulls this front of square to come back for the second.
The batsman works it down the leg side.
Himanshu Rana comes in next.

OUT! Soft dismissal. Slow ball on a good length, Manjot tries to flick it away but the ball just holds up a bit. He is late on the shot and it flies to the short mid-wicket who jumps to take a lovely catch.
Pitched up ball, Gill drives this to mid off for a run.
Tossed up again and Gill milks it to mid on.
Pitched up again in line of the stumps and Manjot works it to mid on for a run.
Tossed up ball, Gill drives it through covers for a run.
Short ball outside off, punched off the back foot to covers where a fumble allows the batsmen to take a run.
On a length, angling in, dabbed neatly to third man for a single.
Shortish delivery on middle and leg, Kalra ducks under it.
Fullish ball on middle and leg, clipped off the front foot to mid-wicket.
Full and outside off, sliced through cover-point for a run.
Fractionally overpitched, driven crisply off the front foot to extra cover.
FOUR! Great short! Takes a step and whips this away. Over pitched delivery and Manjot uses his wrist to hit it towards the mid-wicket region all then way to the fence for a boundary.
Length ball and Manjot gets to the pitch of the ball and defends it.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Length ball around off and Gill places it on the off side for a run.
Tossed up ball, Manjot drives it through covers for a run.
Full length to start with, Gill drives it to mid off.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
The batsman picked that bouncer early and let it through to the keeper.
The batsman drives this through the covers.
They are making use of the vacant short third man region. This time again the ball has been played through that region for a run.
Length ball outside off again and this time Manjot opens the face of the bat towards third man to rotate strike.
Length ball outside off, and Gill guides this towards third man for a run.
Fullish ball, eased to mid on.

Another miscommunication but Gill survives! Kalra taps it towards point. Gill sets off and is almost halfway down the track when he is sent back. He rushes back and dives to make it home safely as the throw comes back to the bowler.
Short and spinning away, Manjot cuts it hard but finds the man at backward point.
Fraction short again, knocked to long on for a single.
Fullish delivery, Kalra caresses it towards sweeper cover and takes a run. The batsmen want the second run but Gill slips.
Hangs back to the shortish ball and punches it to covers.
Short again on middle and leg, Gill pulls this in front of square for a brace.
The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump.
Shubman Gill comes in to bat.

OUT! Oh Dear! Shaw goes for 94. What a chance to get to your century, but he will have to wait until next time. Back of a length ball and it has a little extra bounce on it. Shaw looks to cut it but is beaten by the pace and the bounce on it. Gets the slightest of edges to it and straight into the keeper's gloves.

SIX! Straight from the screws. Short ball on middle and leg, Shaw pulls this ball over the deep square leg region for a maximum. The fielder Waugh stationed there did brilliantly to leap and take it but just managed to get his fingertips to it.
Slow ball and Shaw drives it again to mid off.
Driven through mid off by the batsman.
Will Sutherland comes back to bowl.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Full again and Manjot drives it through covers for a brace.
Tossed up delivery in line of the stumps and Shaw tries going inside-out to it to wide long off. Does not time it well but it goes on the bounce to the fielder at extra cover. They pick up a run.
Shortish ball around off and Shaw rocks back to cut it to point.
Fuller this time and Shaw drives it to covers.
Length ball just outside the off stump and Shaw tries to guide this to third man but misses his cut.
Full on middle and leg, played defensively to the man at mid-wicket. 13 from the over, India motoring along.
Hangs back and tucks it through square leg for a brace.

SIX! Up and over! Pure timing! Shortish delivery on leg stump, Kalra swivels across and pulls it over short fine leg for a maximum. He didn't hit it hard but he is such a sweet timer of the ball. Gets the result he desires.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
FOUR! Power-packed punch! Length ball on off, Kalra stands tall and caresses it past the bowler and mid off for a boundary.
Dug in short, Kalra sits under it in a jiffy.
Wide! Waugh loses his radar and slips this one down the leg side. Kalra looks to glance it but misses.
Slightly overpitched and Shaw drives it back to the bowler.
Fuller this time and Shaw drives it to covers.
Driven through mid on by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Darts this at a good length on leg and Shaw flicks it away to move to the other end.
Half tracker, Shaw works it in front of square on the off side.
Full pitched ball, Shaw drives it to mid on.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Darts this at a good length, Shaw punches the ball for another run.
Another slow ball outside off, Shaw opens the face of the bat and guides it towards third man for another brace.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball.
Wide. Slow ball down the leg and Shaw leaves it alone.
Length ball outside off and Shaw guides this through third man. They take on the arm of the fielder and scamper back for the second run.
FOUR! Short ball and it deserved the punishment. Shaw picks up the length early and slaps it through deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
Overpitched and Manjot drives it to mid off.
Full pitched ball in line of the stumps and Manjot hits it back to the bowler.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
The batsman has driven it through mid on. One run added to the total.
Length ball, forces Manjot on his back foot and he punches it down the ground for another run.
Fuller in length around off and Shaw cuts it behind point for a run.
Full and on leg stump, clipped to mid-wicket.
Short ball and slower in pace, pulled to deep square leg for a single.

Another run out chance missed! Back of a length on off, punched towards mid off. Kalra is again backing up and doesn't have any game awareness. Luckily for him, the shy at the bowler's end misses. He would have been short by a country mile.
Full length ball outside off, Shaw comes forward and plays it with an open bat face to point.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. They pick up a single.
Back of a length outside off, steered to third man for a single.
Wide! Starts off with a loosener. Wide and outside the tramline, Prithvi doesn't fiddle with it.
Austin Waugh comes in for a burst. Australia desperately need a wicket. Is he the man who will deliver?
Fullish on middle, knocked to long on for a run and Shaw will retain strike.
Shortish ball well outside off, placed with the spin through point for a brace.
Leans forward confidently to the loopy ball and pushes it with sweet timing to covers.
Spinning away from Kalra who hangs back and punches it to sweeper cover to rotate strike.
Hangs back to the shortish ball and keeps it out.
Spinning in, tucked wide of mid on for an easy single.
Param Uppal comes on for a bowl.
Driven through the covers by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.

Uppish but safe! Seemed like he timed that really well but that was not the reality. Overpitched on middle, Shaw goes hard at it and just manages to clear the man at mid on. Failed to generate enough power and timing on it. A couple taken.
Fails to capitalize on the Free Hit! Angling into Kalra who makes room to thwack it over the covers but gets a thick outside edge down to third man. A run taken.
No ball! Full length ball, leaving the southpaw. Kalra drives it uppishly past the diving Waugh at point. Merlo has overstepped and a Free Hit is coming up...
In the zone outside off, Kalra doesn't fiddle with it.
Similar delivery, driven to the same region.
Merlo runs in from around the wicket and bowls a full ball on off, pushed crisply to extra cover.
On a length around off, patted to mid off. 9 from this over, India are placed very nicely for a big total.

FOUR! Runs are coming thick and fast for India! There is very little margin for error when you are bowling to the Indian skipper. Length ball outside off, Shaw crouches and slaps it aerially through the point region for a rocketing boundary.
FOUR! Well played! Short ball on middle, tennis-like bounce on that. Shaw plays a forehand smash through mid-wicket and beats the man in the deep to pick up another boundary.

Run out chance missed! That was a poor piece of cricket from Kalra. He is lucky to be still out there. Fullish delivery, Shaw drives it towards mid on and his partner sets off. He is sent back as the throw from the fielder returns at the bowler's end but misses. Had he hit, it would have been curtains for Kalra.
Short and a width on offer, Shaw fails to capitalize on it as he flays it straight to the man at covers.
On the pads, tucked around the corner for a run.
Full ball outside off, stroked to sweeper cover for a run.
FOUR! Sublime! Length ball around off, Kalra stands tall and just times his punch through covers. There is a man at sweeper cover but he has no chance to cut it off. Beautiful timing.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. One run added to the total.

A good example of proper game awareness! Shaw taps this one towards short mid-wicket. Sangha dives to his left, has a shy at the bowler's end as the batsman was backing up but misses. He has been backed up nicely by his teammate. It would have been safe even if he had hit.
Angling into Shaw, tucked with a closed bat face to short mid-wicket.
Starts off with a length ball outside off, holding its line. Shaw plants his front foot across and lets it go.
Jonathan Merlo comes on for a bowl.
Fullish delivery, driven crisply through mid on for a run.

Maiden Under-19 fifty for Manjot Kalra! This has been a beautiful knock so far. Back of a length ball, attacking the rib-cage area, tucked away to square leg for a run. These two have provided the ideal foundation to their side to build upon.
Shortish ball outside off, steered nicely to third man to rotate strike.
Driven towards the mid on region.
Full ball outside off, driven confidently off the front foot to extra cover.

FOUR! Reminiscent of Sachin Tendulkar! Shaw is flowing at the moment. Low full toss on middle, Shaw drives it with a straight bat past the bowler. Sweet timing and the ball whistles away to the fence.
Ralston is back on.
Tossed up delivery, driven off the full face of the bat to mid on.
FOUR! Brilliant! Fullish delivery on middle, Kalra extends his arms and chips it over the vacant mid-wicket region to find the fence.
It's been driven superbly through the covers. One run added to the total.
Short delivery outside off, cut past point for a single.
FOUR! Fell over a bit but did well to hit it in the end. Fast and full outside leg stump, Kalra sweeps it past the keeper towards fine leg for a boundary.

Fifty for Prithvi Shaw! This young boy looks special. Some of the shots that he has played today has been of the highest quality. Shortish delivery around off, Shaw rocks back and cuts it to sweeper cover for a single. Raises his bat skywards and gets a good cheer from the chirpy crowd.
Drinks called!

FOUR! Up and over! Manjot knows the mid off is in and so he waits for the fuller ball. Gets one in the zone and lifts it cleanly over that region to pick up a boundary. There was an element of risk involved but he executed it to perfection.
Shortish and rising a touch off the deck, Manjot gets up on his toes and plays it with an angled bat towards point where Austin Waugh makes a diving stop to his right.
Keeps it really full on the stumps, Kalra jams it out back towards mid off.
Marginally fuller outside off, Manjot drives it to sweeper cover for a single.
Back of a length delivery on middle and leg, tapped towards the left of Edwards for a single.
Angles it away on a length outside off, MK looks to dab it away on the off side but gets beaten.
Flatter one on the pads, clipped through square leg for a single.
Beats the man at cover! Loopy delivery around middle, Manjot makes room and drives it past the diving cover fielder for a couple of runs.
Flighted delivery outside off, driven hard back to the bowler who half-stops it but they don't run.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Loopy leg spinner outside off, punched off the back foot to the cover fielder.
FOUR! Tickled away! Bowls the wrong 'un but it's drifting down leg. Shaw nicely sits back and deflects it past short fine leg. The man gives it a chase but to no avail.

What was that? Slower short ball on middle and leg, Shaw waits for the ball to come and then when it finally comes, Prithvi bends his back knee and swipes it through mid-wicket for a single to keep strike.
Edwards once again drops it short outside off, punched nicely but finds the fielder stationed at point.
Wide! Sprays one down the leg side, Shaw tries clipping it away but fails to get any wood on it.
Shortish on middle, pulled in the gap through mid-wicket to pick up a couple of runs.
Back of a length outside off, steered off the back foot towards point.
A short delivery which has been pulled away. They pick up a single.
Tries to hit the deck hard but there is not much bounce on it. Shaw swivels inside the crease to pull it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
On middle and leg, wristed towards mid on for nothing.

NOT OUT! Shaw is safe! Floated delivery, dipping in on middle, Kalra clears his front leg and drives it straight back towards the bowler. Pope, in his followthrough sticks his right hand out to stop but the ball goes off his fingers to disturb the timber at his end. He appeals for a run out as Shaw plonks his bat inside the crease. It's taken upstairs and replays find the Indian skipper safe.
A run out appeal at the bowler's end is taken upstairs. Prithvi Shaw is the man in question but it seems like he is home...
An appeal for LBW! Drifting in on middle and leg, Kalra stays back to flick it away but misses to get pinged on the pads. They appeal but the umpire stays put. Maybe, it's heading down leg.
Tossed up outside off, driven through cover for a single.
Flatter one outside off, Shaw doesn't play at it.
Starts with a loosener first up. Drops it short on middle, Shaw camps back and pulls it through backward square leg for a brace.
Lloyd Pope is brought into the attack.
Angling away from a length outside off, easily left alone.
Edwards pitches it up on off, Manjot drives it sweetly but finds the man at mid off.
Strays a bit on the pads, Shaw clips it through square leg for one.
On the shorter side, outside off, Shaw stands tall and cuts it hard but finds the man at point.
Good length delivery, slanting away from the southpaw, Kalra glides it down to third man for a single.

In the air... safe! Edwards bangs in a short one, it kicks off the deck. Shaw gets hurried by it but still goes through with his pull shot. Gets a top edge but luckily for him it lands safely near the deep backward square leg region. They take a single.
Touch short and outside off, Prithvi cracks it square of the wicket on the off side for a single to keep strike.
Driven off the meat but finds the man at extra cover.
Drops it on a length and this one comes back in with the angle, Shaw hangs his bat out to poke at it but gets beaten comprehensively.
Pushes this slower delivery towards cover for a single.
Slower one in line of the stumps, defended stoutly back to Sutherland.
FOUR! Uppish but in the gap! Sutherland hurls it full and outside off, Kalra leans forward and drives it uppishly past the diving cover fielder for a boundary to start the over.
Angling into Shaw who tucks it to mid-wicket. Wants a run but is sent back by his partner. The Indian skipper is not pleased.
Full length ball and straight this time, Manjot tucks it around the corner for a single.
Overpitched this time, eased through mid off for a single.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman.
FOUR! Makes full use of the Free Hit! Gets a high full toss in the arc and smokes it over mid-wicket for a boundary. That looked quite high but strangely, hasn't been signaled as a no ball.
No ball! Ooh.. attempted slower ball gone awry. Back of the hand ball outside off, Shaw ducks under it in time to evade it. Time for another Free Hit...
Short and room on offer, Shaw cuts it nicely but finds backward point.
Time for Powerplay 2! Maximum of four fielders will be allowed outside the 30-yard circle till the end of the 40th over.
Dug in short, Kalra ducks under it.
FOUR! Sweet! Good length ball around off, Manjot makes good use of the depth of the crease and the angle to place it through point for a majestic boundary.
On a length, angling away, left alone.
FOUR!  Kalra is oozing confidence! Fullish delivery outside off, Kalra leans ahead and completely commits to it. Lofts it nonchalantly over wide mid off for a one bounce boundary.
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.

Shaw almost commits suicide! He taps the length delivery towards point and takes off. Waugh manning that region is sharp as a hawk. He picks the ball up and aims at the bowler's end but misses. Well, the Indian skipper would have been short by a mile if that hit. Shaw is leading a charmed life!
Back of a length ball outside off, placed wide of backward point for a run. Only 1 from the over, a tight start from Edwards.
Length ball around off, pushed defensively to covers.
On a length outside off, Prithvi doesn't fiddle with it.
Fullish delivery, pushed to covers.
On a length outside off, Shaw plays a push-drive to covers.
In the channel outside off, left alone.
Double change. Jack Edwards to have a bowl now.
FOUR! Beautiful! Length ball around off, Kalra makes good use of the depth of the crease and punches it sweetly through extra cover to pick up a boundary.
Wide! Down the leg side this time, Kalra tries to flick it but misses.
Back of a length ball, pushed off the back foot to cover-point.
Played to the point region by the batsman.
Comes forward to the full delivery and defends it nicely.
Full on middle, patted back to the bowler.
Fails to capitalize on the Free Hit. Flays the full delivery straight to the backward point fielder.

Drama! What could have been a dream start has turned into a nightmare for Sutherland. He has an anguish on his face. How costly will this be? Bowls a slower ball first up outside off by rolling his fingers on it. Shaw comes forward tentatively and has a tame push on it only to nick it behind. Holt behind the stumps crouches and takes it safely. The Australians are celebrating but the umpires tell them to wait. They refer it upstairs to check for the front foot no ball. Oh no! Sutherland has overstepped. There is nothing behind the line and he pays the price for it. The Indian skipper gets a life. To add insult to injury, a Free Hit is coming up...
Will Sutherland comes into the attack.
On a length on off, angling in, clipped nicely through wide mid on. Three runs taken. 11 from the over.
Short ball on off, pulled through square leg for a couple.
It's been driven superbly through the covers.

SIX! Glorious! What a shot! Fullish delivery, angling into Shaw. He waits for it and with a still head lifts it over long on for a maximum. The first one of the game. He is looking set for this stage.
Back of a length ball, dealt from within the crease to cover-point.
Angling in appreciably to Shaw who tucks it to the mid-wicket fielder.
Length ball outside off, played with an open bat face to the point region.
Hangs back and defends this one stoutly.
Nice commitment in the field! Back of a length outside off, punched past the point region. Waugh sprints after it and does really well to cut it off. Two runs taken.

Contrasting styles of play from both the openers. Shaw is a much more compact player and commits himself on both the front foot and back foot while Kalra relies on hand-eye co-ordination. Good combination to go with at the top.
Sharp bouncer on middle, Kalra sways away from the line of the ball to evade it.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot.
Beaten! Nicely bowled. In the corridor of uncertainty, moving away after pitching. Kalra has a feel for it but gets foxed.
On a length in line of the stumps, pushed defensively off the back foot to the leg side.
FOUR! Textbook cover drive! Stand and admire! Full length ball outside off, Shaw leans ahead and drives it elegantly through covers to find the fence.
Ooh.. almost chopped that on! Good length delivery in the avenue of apprehension, Kalra pushes at it gingerly and gets a thick inside edge which goes past the leg stump towards fine leg. A run taken.
Fullish in length outside off, left alone.
All about timing and grace! Fullish and fraction straight this time, Shaw clips it with good balance through mid-wicket and picks up three runs to his name.
Good length ball outside off, shaping in, pushed off the back foot to covers.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman.

Fractionally overpitched arond off, Manjot with minimal foot movement punches it on the up to mid off. This young kid is a good timer of the cricket ball. However, he relies more on hand-eye co-ordination and the Australians need to test him in the zone outside off. Make him play away from his body.
In the zone outside off, leaving the southpaw, he doesn't fiddle with it.

FOUR! Uppish but in the gap! Full ball on middle and leg, Kalra flicks it aerially past the left side of the mid-wicket fielder who sprints after it, puts in a desperate dive near the fence but only comes second best.
Probing wicket-to-wicket line, Kalra camps back and answers it with a straight bat.
Full length ball, shaping away, pushed off the front foot to covers.

Nicely done! Good length ball around off, Prithvi punches it past the bowler. Sutherland from mid off chases it down, slides near the fence and does well to save a couple for his side. 9 from the over, a good one for India.
Fullish on off, swinging in, eased nicely to mid off.

FOUR! This young man certainly packs a punch! Back of a length and width on offer, Shaw stands tall and punches it sweetly through covers. The timing is spot on and the ball whistles away to the fence.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Wide! Loose shot! Full and well outside off, Kalra with minimal foot movement chases it and misses.
Overpitched outside off, driven square of the wicket on the off side.

Good shot and good fielding as well! Pitched up around off, Shaw doesn't try to overhit it and just caresses it towards extra cover. Sutherland moves to his left and dives to make a partial stop. Only a run taken.
Fullish delivery, a bit of width on offer. Kalra leans forward and taps it with an open bat face to point.
Short of a length ball on off, Kalra camps back and defends it with a straight bat.
Fuller in length, driven sweetly off the front foot to mid off.
Back of a length on off, angling away, placed nicely to the point region.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman.

FOUR! Beauty! Everything was so good about that shot. Fractionally overpitched on off, Kalra shows the full face of the bat and drives it gloriously past mid off to find the fence. Ganguly on air says that he reminds him of a young Shikhar Dhawan. Similar bat swing and packs a punch.
Jason Ralston to bowl with the second new ball from the other end.
Drags his length back this time, pushed to covers off the back foot. Bartlett starts off with a maiden.
Pitched up this time on off, driven crisply back to the bowler.
A bit tentative! Good bowling from Bartlett. He steams in and bowls a good length ball around off, angling in. Shaw pushes at it with hard hands and gets an inside edge towards short mid-wicket.
Back of a length around off, seaming in after pitching. Prithvi hangs back and punches it firmly to covers. He is looking solid so far.
On a length in the corridor of uncertainty, Shaw leans ahead and plays it with an angled bat to point.
Starts off with a fullish  delivery around off, Shaw has his feet moving well and defends it stoutly.

The players make their way to the middle for the National Anthems. After the completion, we are set to get underway. Prithvi Shaw and Manjot Karla to open the batting for India. Xavier Bartlett to start off the proceedings will the ball. Here we go...
PITCH REPORT - Ian Bishop says that the pitch looks pretty dry. Informs the slower bowlers will enjoy bowling themselves on this track. Feels that it will be a good contest between bat and ball.
Australia Under-19s XI - M Bryant, J Edwards, JJS Sangha (c), J Merlo, P Uppal, A Waugh, W Sutherland, BJ Holt (wk), X Bartlett, JT Ralston, L Pope.
India Under-19s XI - PP Shaw (c), Manjot Kalra, Shubman Gill, HJ Rana, Abhishek Sharma, A Juyal, AS Roy, KL Nagarkoti, Shivam Mavi, Shiva Singh, IC Porel.

Jason Sangha, Australia skipper, says that losing the toss is not a bad thing. Mentions they will be aiming to restrict India and chase the target down. States that the conditions are similar to the one when they faced Sri Lanka in the warm-up fixture. Ends by saying that they will be aiming to put in a good performance.

Prithvi Shaw, India skipper, says that they are going to bat first. Mentions that it looks a good wicket. Informs that it is a great opportunity for them. States that it is an advantage for them that many of their players have first-class experience leading into the World Cup.
Toss - India win the toss and opt to bat.

Australia, on the other hand, will feel much more at home as compared to their opposition. They have a good pace attack and the sideways movement on offer will certainly aid them. Jason Sangha, the skipper, is a good cricketer and will strive to inspire his teammates. Will Sutherland is another one to watch out for and is known for his crafty all-round skills. Both teams have won the World Cup thrice and will be eager to have a great campaign. Expect a cracker! Stay with us as the toss is coming up in a bit...

Hello and a warm welcome to the coverage of the 7th match of the ICC Under-19 World Cup. Two strong contenders, India and Australia, are set to battle it out in Tauranga. Both sides won their warm-up fixture with ease and are in good shape. The Rahul Dravid-led Indian side is pretty well-balanced but the Kiwi conditions will definitely test them. The skipper, Prithvi Shaw and the vice-captain, Shubman Gill are bright prospects for the future and will be keenly eyed upon. Arshdeep Singh is likely to spearhead the pace attack and is an exciting talent as well.
